chat-security-fix.needs_from_others: 1) Client: the chat request should send `source: "link"` when the message came from a link or prompt button, otherwise `source: "typed"` or nothing. Chat failures are always JSON, with 422 {message, errors}, 404 {message} and 429 {message}. A 429 can now also mean 'Wait for the current answer to finish.' (a second concurrent answer), and the general limit is now 5 chat requests a minute per user (ai-generation), so the client must show the message and not retry blindly. The reasoning events now arrive one whole line at a time, so the panel updates in line steps. A hidden assistant message (officer lost the module) comes back with payload null and fixed text, so the message list must tolerate a null payload on an assistant message. 2) FallbackTextGenerator::converse and ClaudeMessagesService (not my files): to finish the sec-03 deadline, pass the remaining time budget (answer deadline minus elapsed) into converse so the primary and secondary together stay within chat_timeout + 15 s. FallbackTextGenerator already has a private timeBudget mechanism that converse does not use. Today my code stops at the next model event past the deadline, but a provider that sends nothing still holds the worker until its own timeout. 3) AskAiService::recentQueries (not my file, optional): skip context_version 'ask-ai-chat-v1' so the overview does not list chat turns, and consider a scheduled prune of ASK_AI_ASSISTANT rows. 4) Contract: the line 'writes use throttle:api-write' should say POST /ai/assistant/chat uses throttle:ai-generation and the per-user lock. The regenerate rule in section 5 should say it answers the last user message and 422s only when there is none. 5) Existing test expectation changed in AnswerMarkdownTest: a label with brackets, `See [[a] page](https://evil.test)`, now yields `See \\[a\\] page`, because every leftover bracket is escaped. In AskAiChatTest two tests used `/dashboard/ask-ai` as an allowed link and now use /dashboard/records, since that link is correctly refused. The error-event test's anonymous respond() gained the `$source` parameter."

outcomes_not_fixed.note: The chat route now uses throttle:ai-generation (5 a minute per user). One running answer per user is held by Cache::lock('ask-ai-chat:'.school_id, 150), taken after validation. It is released in a finally block (JSON branch) or in the stream callback, and a second request gets 429 JSON {message: 'Wait for the current answer to finish.'}. The whole answer has one deadline of chat_timeout + 15 s, checked on every model event in AskAiChatService. When it passes, the stream is interrupted and the answer comes from the records. NOT fully fixed: a provider call that sends no events (a hung primary, or Groq's single non-streaming call) cannot be interrupted from my files. Capping the primary and secondary together needs a time budget passed through FallbackTextGenerator::converse (see needs_from_others).

3) I did not edit the capabilities answer in AskAiService. It should list AskAiActions::titlesFor($user).
4) Contract-adjacent facts for the client builder:
- Empty `errors` is stored and sent as `[]`, not `{}`, because the JSON cast turns an empty array into a list. The 422 route response uses the real map.
- Proposal payloads set `intent: null`, because AskAiChatService hides any unknown intent from students and so would hide the card on reload.
- While a confirm is running the action status is briefly `confirming`. It is not in the contract's status list, so the client should treat an unknown status as read-only. If PHP is killed mid-run the card stays at `confirming`, and later presses get 409.
5) Not covered: a route-level 'archived organization' refusal for a role in this set. A member of an archived organization is stopped earlier by the account-profile middleware (403), which the test proves. A college archived after the proposal is refused on the card as 'Choose one of the listed options.', also tested.
6) Not covered: the 'Event dates must fall within the academic semester' 422 (no field) is checked only through the error-mapping helper, not through a semester fixture.
7) The proposal message writes no ai_outputs row, since nothing is generated or audited at that point. The real route writes its own audit row on confirm.
8) The 'Everyone' audience and the grievance destination are required selects with no default, because I am told never to invent a value. The person must pick them on the card.
9) Not tested against a real model provider; the tests use a scripted fake. A real model call must be checked with `ai:live-eval` or by hand."
